Anyone can make their own tunes in Forza. It comes down to doing the right math, taking a test drive and knowing when to make a few adjustments. Nothing magic. ForzaTune Pro does the complex math for you, and makes it easy to adjust the car to your driving style and skill.

Tell ForzaTune you're driving a Supra on the streets of Mexico, and it creates a tune to match. If you prefer a more aggressive or more stable feel, then open up the tune customizer to set oversteer or understeer in each part of a turn. ForzaTune works out the new values for you automatically.

There's nothing better than driving a car dialed in how you want it. And a car that feels planted helps you drive faster.

This Pro version includes many extra tuning types like rally, drag and drift plus gearing options, the ability to save tunes, and finer control over your tune balance.

Here are the complete specs if you'd like to learn more:

ONE APP TO TUNE THEM ALL
ForzaTune Pro has support for Forza Horizon 5, Forza Horizon 4, Forza Motorsport 7 and also includes most vehicles in Forza Horizon 3 and Forza Motorsport 6.

MAKE STREET, DRIFT, RALLY TUNES AND MORE
No matter what kind of driving you like, this tuning app has you covered. Create standard (street/track), drift, drag, rain, rally/snow, and off-road tunes with ease.

LEARN HOW TO QUICKLY FINE-TUNE
Adjust the overall balance, turn entry balance, turn exit balance, ride stiffness, roll stiffness in seconds.

RETUNE GEARS WITH EASE
Includes a gearing calculator option that lets you match race and drift transmission values to engine swaps or major power upgrades. 

TUNES ARE TAILORED TO EACH CAR
1200+ vehicles covering Forza Horizon 5 back through Forza Motorsport 6. Tuning for some special editions (F&F, Team Forza, FE) is done with the base car unless noted otherwise. ForzaTune does not include oval racing vehicles or tuning.

ACCURATE FORMULAS
ForzaTune Pro combines your input with its vehicle and track databases to create original, balanced tunes. Formulas are based on race engineering but adjusted for Forza. They are also tested extensively with a gamepad and steering wheel/pedal set.

SAVE AND MANAGE YOUR TUNES
Save, edit, search and backup all of your tunes. Export and import options let you transfer your tunes to new devices or friends easily without logins or accounts.

FAQs

A: Both. Experienced tuners use it to save time. Newer tuners use it to learn how to tune.
